C0527.title: Douyin Removes Merchants Exploiting Ultra-Low-Price Presales and Shipping Insurance Arbitrage
C0527.summary: Douyin's e-commerce platform removed a batch of stores engaging in irregular operations using low-priced goods. These merchants advertised items like a '15.9 yuan mangosteen gift box' with shipping insurance but set a 120-day presale period, exploiting extended delivery times or shipping insurance rules for arbitrage, thereby harming consumer interests.

references.title: These low-price merchants are in danger, Douyin removes 1,000 stores
